description.value: Sachi Sushi has been a Whistler institution since 2003, earning the Best Sushi award in the Pique Newspaper's Best of Whistler competition and a glowing mention in Lonely Planet. Owner and head chef Toshiyuki Kobayashi brings over 30 years of sushi experience, with a focus on the freshest ingredients in creative rolls and sashimi. Located in the Summit Lodge on Main Street, it's a popular walk-in-only spot that draws visitors from around the world.
